crop.notes: Whole 'One More for Muldoon' wrestling report, headlines to end.

ocr.notes: Readable; left-edge letters dropped in the opening columns ('ashionable', 'vhich') and scattered errors ('Tom Alien', 'Baver').

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen, "the late world's champion of the prize ring," served as Bauer's umpire at Masonic hall, where Muldoon beat Theobaud Bauer two Greco-Roman falls out of three.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Sunday Morning, January 28, 1883', page 11.

facts.fact: Allen served as umpire for Theobaud Bauer in his Greco-Roman wrestling match with Muldoon at Masonic hall, St. Louis; Muldoon won two falls out of three

notes: Allen appears only in one paragraph (called up by referee Tom Kelly, clumsy climbing onto the stage); the rest is the match. Related to fact 030 (referees a wrestling match), but he was umpire here, not referee, so not linked.
